Inspect a raw file

Source: R/tda.R
tda_ccnt.Rd

Small file-diagnostic utilities from TDA's toolkit, from an era before assuming wc, od or split were available: tda_ccnt a character frequency table, tda_lcnt a record-length frequency table, tda_dump a hex dump, and tda_dsplit splits a file into fixed-size parts on disk.

Usage

tda_ccnt(file, dir = tempfile("tda"), ...)

tda_lcnt(file, noc = NULL, dir = tempfile("tda"), ...)

tda_dump(file, nc = NULL, offset = NULL, dir = tempfile("tda"), ...)

tda_dsplit(file, len = NULL, dir = tempfile("tda"), ...)

Arguments

file

path to the file to inspect.

dir

working directory; for tda_dsplit, also where the parts are written, alongside the original file.

...

passed to tda_run.

noc

for tda_lcnt, the maximum number of records to read.

nc

for tda_dump, how many bytes to show; all of them by default.

offset

for tda_dump, where to start, in bytes.

len

for tda_dsplit, the size of each part in bytes.

Value

tda_ccnt and tda_lcnt return a data frame. tda_dump returns the hex dump as a character vector, one line each. tda_dsplit returns the paths of the parts it wrote.

See also

Other TDA infrastructure: tda_help(), tda_output(), tda_read_table(), tda_run(), tda_write_data()

Examples

f <- tempfile()
writeLines(c("hello world", "foo bar baz", "x"), f)
tda_ccnt(f)
#>    char hex count
#> 1  <NA>  0A     3
#> 2  <NA>  20     3
#> 3     a  61     2
#> 4     b  62     2
#> 5     d  64     1
#> 6     e  65     1
#> 7     f  66     1
#> 8     h  68     1
#> 9     l  6C     3
#> 10    o  6F     4
#> 11    r  72     2
#> 12    w  77     1
#> 13    x  78     1
#> 14    z  7A     1
tda_lcnt(f)
#>   index length frequency
#> 1     1      1         1
#> 2     2     11         2
cat(tda_dump(f), sep = "\n")
#> 00000000 : 68 65 6c 6c 6f 20 77 6f 72 6c 64 0a 66 6f 6f 20   hello world.foo 
#> 00000010 : 62 61 72 20 62 61 7a 0a 78 0a                     bar baz.x.

f2 <- tempfile()
writeLines(rep("0123456789", 10), f2)
tda_dsplit(f2, len = 20)
#> [1] "/tmp/Rtmp62wydu/tda1f59687f3279/file1f591d43100.a"
#> [2] "/tmp/Rtmp62wydu/tda1f59687f3279/file1f591d43100.b"
#> [3] "/tmp/Rtmp62wydu/tda1f59687f3279/file1f591d43100.c"
#> [4] "/tmp/Rtmp62wydu/tda1f59687f3279/file1f591d43100.d"
#> [5] "/tmp/Rtmp62wydu/tda1f59687f3279/file1f591d43100.e"
#> [6] "/tmp/Rtmp62wydu/tda1f59687f3279/file1f591d43100.f"
